rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for financially supporting someone or something with a subsidy.

example.english: The government agrees to subsidize this community centre so it can keep running classes.
example.traditional: 政府資助呢個社區中心，等佢可以繼續開班。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zi1 zo6 nei1 go3 se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 dang2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 hoi1 baan1

rows.note: Use this when the subsidy covers part of a cost, price, or financial shortfall.

example.english: Our company provides money to subsidize the employees’ transport costs.
example.traditional: 我哋公司補貼員工嘅交通費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 bou2 tip3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 gaau1 tung1 fai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing help with someone's expenses rather than an official subsidy.

example.english: The income from this part-time job can help subsidize the household expenses.
example.traditional: 呢份兼職啲收入，可以幫補下屋企開支。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gim1 zik1 di1 sau1 jap6 ho2 ji5 bong1 bou2 haa5 uk1 kei2 hoi1 zi1
